description: Renderer-neutral quality and pixel-ratio policy with parent-sized Pixi, React Three Fiber and Babylon mounts.
rules: Import the renderer-neutral core from game-mount and adapters from their isolated subpaths.
Install only the peers required by the selected adapter; every package peer is optional.
Give the host a resolved height and create a fresh canvas for each Pixi Application.
Use RenderQuality and the shared DPR policy; do not introduce uncapped device ratios.
Havok physics is an opt-in entry point; applications serve its WASM and enable scene physics.
